result:
Nothing new shipped this run. I couldn't take or score new pictures because the screenshot camera and the critic aren't allowed commands here. The title family (01, 44, 45, 57) is done as far as I can take it. Four things are not met:
- **Scores:** 01 and 45 score 3, not 4. 44 and 57 score 2, from older pictures that predate the saves, legend and lowercase fixes, so they are probably higher now but unscored.
- **60 fps at 4K:** not measured, because I have no tool for it. I did cut the per-frame backdrop blur to 2px, and the fight is only a few bodies, bolts and capped sparks.
- **Open findings (01, 44, 57):** the logo gradient, the five ordered mode rows, the saves block as a form and the fullscreen button all wait on him.
- **Open findings (45):** the card's rows, buttons and spacing are task 12's.

The one-line title (Q51), no raiders beside the logo (Q53), no PvP row (Q72) and the live pillager-versus-robot backdrop (Q52, Q54) are all shipped. The backdrop shipped in v30.69, v30.82 and v31.19.

I added a run 10 entry to the notes.

TASK PARTIAL: 01 and 45 are at 3 and 44 and 57 are unscored on current pictures; re-shoot and critic them when the camera is available, and the open findings wait on him or task 12.
